name: External Investigation Action 1 Code
definition: Specifies the requested action, as published in an external investigation action code set.|External code sets can be downloaded from www.iso20022.org.

RQCL.name: Request Investigation Closure
RQCL.definition: Responder is requested to close the investigation. All investigation requests relating to the investigation may be disregarded.

RQST.name: Request Investigation Status
RQST.definition: Responder is requested to provide the status of the investigation.

RQOB.name: Request Objection
RQOB.definition: Responder is requested to review an earlier response as the requestor objects to it.

RQRO.name: Request Investigation Reopening
RQRO.definition: Responder is requested to reopen the investigation.
